headline: Xbox’s first chief operating officer is out after just a few months
summary: Xbox's first COO, Helen Chiang, is departing Microsoft. Chiang leaves the role just months after its creation. She previously headed Minecraft during her 21 years at Microsoft.

headline: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
summary: OpenAI is training its top AI models in an offline environment. This measure follows recent "rogue hacking incidents." Models interact with cached web content, mitigating external risks.

headline: Abandoned Popcorn Time apps disabled to prevent "zombie army"
summary: Long-abandoned Popcorn Time apps were actively disabled. The "Netflix of Piracy" software could have formed a botnet. Millions of installed devices were potential zombie army members.

headline: Jack Dorsey’s Block unveils "awkward" conversational AI, Dessa
summary: Block, founded by Jack Dorsey, introduced a new AI model named Dessa. Dessa is trained exclusively on human conversation, showing uncanny interactions. The AI's chats can be a little awkward, resembling a new acquaintance.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Promoted With Baseball-Themed Crossover During World Series
summary: Marvel Studios debuted a unique promo for Avengers: Doomsday. The ad was an Avengers-MLB crossover during the 2026 World Series. It featured MLB players in a baseball-themed setting on Earth-828.

headline: Aaron Paul Makes Surprise Cameo in DC’s Clayface
summary: Emmy winner Aaron Paul has a brief cameo in the new DC movie Clayface. The Breaking Bad star's appearance is in DC's first R-rated horror film. Director James Watkins explained the reason behind the surprise role.

headline: Dead by Daylight to Remove Chucky Content, Months After Losing Michael Myers
summary: Dead by Daylight is set to remove all Chucky-themed content. Fans are upset as this follows the recent loss of Michael Myers content. The content will no longer be available for purchase starting next month.

headline: Barnes & Noble Sells First Dungeon Crawler Carl Jigsaw Puzzle
summary: Barnes & Noble is now offering a unique Dungeon Crawler Carl item. It's the first ever 500-piece jigsaw puzzle based on the series. Fans can find the collectible at the popular bookstore.

headline: France prepares for day of protest after nationwide riots
summary: France expects hundreds of thousands to join protests today. Over 70,000 police officers are deployed amidst potential defiance. The demonstrations come a week after widespread national riots.

headline: Met investigates letter detailing claims about Meghan's father
summary: Scotland Yard has opened an inquiry into a letter concerning Meghan's father. The Duchess of Sussex reported receiving the letter. It allegedly contained "disturbing allegations" about her father.

headline: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
summary: The UK plans to invest £100m in a new AI Biosecurity Lab. It's touted as a "world first" initiative. The funding aims to bolster the UK's defenses and will be unveiled in the Budget.

headline: Oregon father who killed gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
summary: Kaylub Giamanco, hailed a hero, killed an Oregon school gunman. He describes deep anguish over children he couldn't protect. The gunman fatally shot three children and a teacher.
